task.title: Fetch from Remotes
task.shortdesc: Download the latest commits and branch information from your remotes without changing your working copy.

context.p: Fetching updates your remote-tracking information — what the and views show — so you can see what's on the remote before you pull. It never merges or changes your files.

step.cmd: Start a fetch in any of these ways:

choices.choice: From the menu or the menu, select to fetch from all configured remotes.

In the
view, right-click the
node to fetch all remotes, or a specific remote such as origin to fetch just that one.

result.p: The and views update to reflect the latest remote state.
